scope: Pump.fun exact-alpha V2 feature research only; no V1 outcomes, validation, holdout, or 8YCB material inspected

evidence_grades.A: Repeated empirical support in large data and/or an unusually direct platform mechanism, with causal-time construction possible.
evidence_grades.B: Strong single-study, open-data, or mechanism-backed evidence, but not yet replicated for the exact Pump.fun early-entry objective.
evidence_grades.C: Indirect empirical or practitioner evidence; useful as a falsifiable hypothesis.
evidence_grades.D: Speculative, highly proxy-dependent, or contradicted/too weak for promotion without new prospective evidence.
